name: Artificial Intelligence Minor
intro: This minor in Artificial Intelligence — using course work from the Thomas Lord Department of Computer Science, the Ming Hsieh Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, and the Daniel J. Epstein Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering — will permit students in STEM disciplines to develop additional skills in the theory and use of artificial intelligence.
